11145-the-discovery-of-yellowstone-park-.description: A book by Nathaniel Pitt Langford. ojourn in the Rocky Mountains commenced as early as the year 1820, and in 1832 we find him a resident partner in the Rocky Mountain Fur Company. He frequently spent periods of time varying from three months to two years, so far removed from any settlement or trading post, that neither flour nor bread stuffs in any form could be obtained, the only available substitute for bread being the various roots found in the Rocky Mountain region.

75553-among-the-camps.title: _Young People’S Stories Of The War_
75553-among-the-camps.creator: Thomas Nelson Page
75553-among-the-camps.description: A book by Thomas Nelson Page. Holly Hill was the place for Christmas! From Bob down to brown-eyed Evelyn, with her golden hair floating all around her, every one hung up a stocking, and the visit of Santa Claus was the event of the year.

arxiv-1806-05579.title: A new approach for American option pricing: The Dynamic Chebyshev method
arxiv-1806-05579.creator: Kathrin Glau, Mirco Mahlstedt, Christian Pötz
arxiv-1806-05579.description: Abstract We introduce a new method to price American options based on Chebyshev interpolation. In each step of a dynamic programming time-stepping we approximate the value function with Chebyshev polynomials. The key advantage of this approach is that it allows to shift the model-dependent computations into an offline phase prior to the time-stepping.

arxiv-2101-12011.title: COVID-19 propagation by diffusion - a two-dimensional approach for Germany
arxiv-2101-12011.creator: Günter Bärwolff
arxiv-2101-12011.description: Abstract Diffusion comes anytime and everywhere. If there is a gradient or a potential difference of a quantity a diffusion process happens and this ends if an equilibrium is reached only. The concentration of a species maybe such quantity, or the voltage. An electric currant will be driven by a voltage difference for example.

arxiv-2209-01997.title: Intersection Numbers from Higher-order Partial Differential Equations
arxiv-2209-01997.creator: Vsevolod Chestnov, Hjalte Frellesvig, Federico Gasparotto, Manoj K. Mandal, Pierpaolo Mastrolia
arxiv-2209-01997.description: Abstract We propose a new method for the evaluation of intersection numbers for twisted meromorphic n n -forms, through Stokes’ theorem in n n dimensions. It is based on the solution of an n n -th order partial differential equation and on the evaluation of multivariate residues. We also present an algebraic expression for the contribution from each multivariate residue.

arxiv-2209-02871.title: Improving Choral Music Separation through Expressive Synthesized Data from Sampled Instruments
arxiv-2209-02871.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by . Choral music separation refers to the task of extracting tracks of voice parts (e.g., soprano, alto, tenor, and bass) from mixed audio. The lack of datasets has impeded research on this topic as previous work has only been able to train and evaluate models on a few minutes of choral music data due to copyright issues and dataset collection difficulties. In this paper, we investigate the use of synthesized training data for the source separation task on real choral music.

arxiv-2308-12265.title: Network Navigation with Online Delays is \PSPACE -complete
arxiv-2308-12265.creator: Thomas Depian and Christoph Kern 1 and Sebastian Röder 1 and Soeren Terziadis and Markus Wallinger 2
arxiv-2308-12265.description: Abstract In public transport networks disruptions may occur and lead to travel delays. It is thus interesting to determine whether a traveler can be resilient to delays that occur unexpectedly, ensuring that they can reach their destination in time regardless. We model this as a game between the traveler and a delay-introducing adversary.

arxiv-2311-18728.title: Quantum Simulation of an Open System: A Dissipative 1+1D Ising Model
arxiv-2311-18728.creator: Erik Gustafson a , Michael Hite b , Jay Hubisz c , Bharath Sambasivam c , Judah Unmuth-Yockey a
arxiv-2311-18728.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Erik Gustafson a , Michael Hite b , Jay Hubisz c , Bharath Sambasivam c , Judah Unmuth-Yockey a. The 1+1D Ising model is an ideal benchmark for quantum algorithms, as it is very well understood theoretically. This is true even when expanding the model to include complex coupling constants. In this work, we implement quantum algorithms designed for the simulation of open or complex coupling quantum field theories on IBM devices with a focus on the measurement of the Lee-Yang edge singularity.

arxiv-2402-17748.title: Exploring the Market Dynamics of Liquid Staking Derivatives (LSDs)
arxiv-2402-17748.creator: Xihan Xiong 2 , Zhipeng Wang 2 , Qin Wang 3
arxiv-2402-17748.description: Abstract Staking has emerged as a crucial concept following Ethereum’s transition to Proof-of-Stake consensus. The introduction of Liquid Staking Derivatives (LSDs) has effectively addressed the illiquidity issue associated with solo staking, gaining significant market attention. This paper analyzes the LSD market dynamics from the perspectives of both liquidity takers (LTs) and liquidity providers (LPs).

arxiv-2411-12080.title: Controlled Occupied Processes and Viscosity Solutions
arxiv-2411-12080.creator: H. Mete Soner, Valentin Tissot-Daguette, Jianfeng Zhang
arxiv-2411-12080.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by H. Mete Soner, Valentin Tissot-Daguette, Jianfeng Zhang. We consider the optimal control of occupied processes which record all positions of the state process. Dynamic programming yields nonlinear equations on the space of positive measures. We develop the viscosity theory for this infinite dimensional parabolic occupied PDE by proving a comparison result between sub and supersolutions, and thus provide a characterization of the value function as the unique viscosity solution.

arxiv-2511-12737.title: From Images to Physics: Probabilistic Inference of Galaxy Parameters and Emission Lines via VAE–Normalizing Flows
arxiv-2511-12737.creator: Adiba Amira Siddiqa, Sayed Shafaat Mahmud, Rafael Martinez-Galarza
arxiv-2511-12737.description: Abstract We introduce a Variational Autoencoder (VAE)–Normalizing Flow (NF) framework for rapid probabilistic inference of galaxy properties and emission line fluxes at z ≤ 0.3 z\leq 0.3 from SDSS gri imaging and photometry. Our model probabilistically infers stellar mass, star formation rate (SFR), redshift, gas-phase metallicity, and central black hole mass for a given galaxy.

pmc-10510807.creator: Audra R. Meadows, Renée Byfield, Debra Bingham, Hafsatou Diop
pmc-10510807.description: Perinatal quality collaboratives are associated with improvements in obstetric outcomes and strategies to advance equity. Rapidly rising maternal morbidity and mortality rates and persistent racial and ethnic inequities reinforce a national call to action to prioritize improvements in maternal health, safety, and equity.

pmc-10550326.title: Role of digital health in coordinating patient care in a hub-and-spoke hierarchy of cancer care facilities: a scoping review
pmc-10550326.creator: Ramachandran Venkataramanan, Akash Pradhan, Abhishek Kumar, Mohannad Alajlani, Theodorus N Arvanitis
pmc-10550326.description: BackgroundCoordinating cancer care is complicated due to the involvement of multiple service providers which often leads to fragmentation. The evolution of digital health has led to the development of technology-enabled models of healthcare delivery. This scoping review provides a comprehensive summary of the use of digital health in coordinating cancer care via hub-and-spoke models.

pmc-10675542.title: Artifact Augmentation for Enhanced Tissue Detection in Microscope Scanner Systems
pmc-10675542.creator: Dániel Küttel, László Kovács, Ákos Szölgyén, Róbert Paulik, Viktor Jónás, Miklós Kozlovszky, Béla Molnár
pmc-10675542.description: As the field of routine pathology transitions into the digital realm, there is a surging demand for the full automation of microscope scanners, aiming to expedite the process of digitizing tissue samples, and consequently, enhancing the efficiency of case diagnoses.

pmc-10773859.title: Integrated comparative transcriptome and physiological analysis reveals the metabolic responses underlying genotype variations in NH4 + tolerance
pmc-10773859.creator: Haifei Chen, Wei Lv, Wenqi Zhang, Jie Zhao, Quan Zhang, Zhenhua Zhang
pmc-10773859.description: Several mechanisms have been proposed to explain NH4 + toxicity. However, the core information about the biochemical regulation of plants in response to NH4 + toxicity is still lacking. In this study, the tissue NH4 + concentration is an important factor contributing to variations in plant growth even under nitrate nutrition and NH4 + tolerance under ammonium nutrition.

pmc-12660928.title: Subarachnoid hemorrhage mediates human neocortical network, membrane potential, and action potential bursting via glutamate receptors
pmc-12660928.creator: De-Fong Huang, Ming-Yi Chou, Yu-Hsuan Lee, Yi-Tzu Chen, Chi-Kuang Sun, Kuo-Chuan Wang, Hsien-Sung Huang
pmc-12660928.description: Subarachnoid hemorrhage (SAH) is a life-threatening neurological emergency with high mortality and morbidity rates. Despite its severity, the acute and direct neuronal effects of SAH remain poorly understood, particularly in human brain tissue. To address this gap, we applied cerebrospinal fluid from individuals with SAH (SAH-CSF) to human neocortical slices and examined neuronal activity and intrinsic properties.

pmc-13137959.title: Ubiquitin-Modifying Enzymes as Cell-Fate Regulators in Intestinal Inflammation
pmc-13137959.creator: Chenchen Qian, Fangmin Ning, Yong Xu, Jingjing Shao, Binglu Shi, Chenjian Zhou, Yi Wang
pmc-13137959.description: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), including ulcerative colitis (UC) and Crohn's disease (CD), is a chronic, relapsing inflammatory disorder of the gastrointestinal tract. Intestinal homeostasis relies on the intricate balance of cell fate decisions within the intestinal epithelium and immune compartments.

pmc-13144852.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A2180 ATYPICAL STROKE: ATHEROEMBOLISM FROM THE COMMON CAROTID ARTERY TO BRANCHES OF THE POSTERIOR CEREBRAL ARTERY
pmc-13144852.creator: Daniel Antonio Ginarte Milanés, Elena Garcés Becerril, Oscar Fabre, Carlos Tejero-Juste, Laura Collado, Victor Moneva
pmc-13144852.description: Background and aimsThe presence of an organized thrombus in the common carotid artery can generate microemboli to uncommon cerebral territories, especially in the presence of anatomical variants, causing atypical ischemic strokes. In this case, we present this rare clinical scenario.MethodsDescriptive presentation of a clinical case.

pmc-13268114.title: Pragmatic Clinical Trial Assessing Response to Neoadjuvant Docetaxel and Trastuzumab in Nigerian Women With Human Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor 2–Positive Breast Cancer (ARETTA)
pmc-13268114.creator: Atara Ntekim, Abiodun Popoola, Anthonia Sowunmi, Olalekan Olasehinde, Ayodele Sanni, Abiola Ibraheem, Yonglan Zheng, Toshio F Yoshimatsu, Gideon T Dosunmu, Olasubomi Omoleye, Ayorinde Folasire, Adenike Adeniji-Sofoluwe, Adeleye Omisore, Alabi Adewumi, Thomas Olajide, Razak Lawal, Akinwunmi Komolafe,
pmc-13268114.description: PURPOSEBreast cancer is the leading cause of death in Nigerian women. Clinical trials are required to provide evidence for treatment. pmc-13458087.title: Bioengineered Zn2TiO4 nanomaterial and its effective electrochemical, antibacterial and photocatalytic responses
pmc-13458087.creator: A. Fall, K. K. Masibi, N. L. Botha, KJ. Cloete, R. Ahmed, M. Maaza
pmc-13458087.description: Bioengineering of bimetallic oxides is a significant requirement for both social and environmental applications. More accurately, natural extract/phyto-compounds of Hibiscus sabdariffa was validated as an effective chelating agent at room temperature and atmospheric pressure.

uslaw-usc-t31-s734.description: United States Code, Title 31 (Money And Finance); Chapter 7 (Government Accountability Office); Subchapter III (Personnel). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Comptroller General may assign or detail an officer or employee of the Government Accountability Office to full-time continuous duty with a committee of Congress for not more than one year.
